## Summary

Built drive-reach 1.1 and 1.2. The driver keeps <state base>/runs/<run>.json beside the run lock. It is written at take, each turn head, each handoff and the stop; done moves at handoffs only, because the driver never folds per poll tick. A write failure is one warning, never a stop. `sofar drive` records launched_by from CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, else CODEX_THREAD_ID; `--detach` carries it across the clean-env break as SOFAR_DRIVE_LAUNCHED_BY, which driven sessions never inherit. Cursor exports no session id and the session pointer is last-writer-wins, so Cursor-launched runs name no launcher: a D35 gap for 1.3/2.1 to weigh. Full suite: the same 9 failures before and after (timeouts under load, plus digest-cache Rust/TS parity over the live records); in isolation only digest-cache fails.
